PredictBy is a research and consulting firm focused on social, behavioural and data science. Our interdisciplinary team operates from offices in Bonn and Barcelona. PredictBy has broad expertise in EU policy and regulation in the areas of health, climate change, public sector reform and digital transformation. 

 

Why join us? 

PredictBy is the right size to be ambitious without being bureaucratic. We work as one team across our offices in Bonn and Barcelona. The Bonn office is small today and growing. 

Joining the Bonn office at this stage means working directly with senior consultants and partners from day one, on substantive projects for EU institutions and other public-sector clients. We work in a direct, collaborative way, focused on the quality of what we deliver rather than on the overhead of large firms. 

 

The role 

As a Research Consultant, you will be part of a multidisciplinary, dynamic, and growing team in Bonn and Barcelona, working in a collaborative and intellectually stimulating environment. You will contribute to projects for the European Commission, the European Parliament, EU agencies and national governments: evaluations, impact assessments, studies, and applied research that informs how policies are designed, implemented and reviewed.   • Conduct desk research (e.g. systematic and scoping literature reviews, policy and document analysis).
